Mission Local reported that three friends arrived at the GameStop on Mission Street at 6 a.m. to buy “Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom.” Over the next three hours, about 10 other gamers joined the line. The friends were hoping to get a limited collector’s edition, and their early start secured them the first three purchase slots.
